_comment: Vapi Tool Definitions for Patient Registration System. The server URL points to your webhook (e.g. https://your-domain.ngrok-free.app/vapi/webhook).
firstMessage: Hi, thanks for calling our clinic! My name is Muhammad, and I can help you register as a new patient today. Could I start with your first and last name?

function.name: create_patient
function.description: Create a new patient record in the persistent database after reading back and receiving explicit confirmation from the caller.

first_name.description: Caller's first name (1-50 alphabetic characters, hyphens or apostrophes allowed)

last_name.description: Caller's last name (1-50 alphabetic characters, hyphens or apostrophes allowed)

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format (must be a valid date, not in the future)

phone_number.description: 10-digit U.S. phone number without punctuation or country code, e.g. 5551234567

address_line_2.description: Optional apartment, unit, or suite number

state.description: 2-letter U.S. state postal abbreviation, e.g. TX, CA, NY

zip_code.description: 5-digit U.S. ZIP code or ZIP+4 (e.g. 78701 or 78701-1234)

insurance_provider.description: Optional name of health insurance company (e.g. Blue Cross)

insurance_member_id.description: Optional alphanumeric health insurance member ID

preferred_language.description: Optional preferred language, defaults to English

function.name: find_patient_by_phone
function.description: Check if an existing active patient record already exists with the given 10-digit phone number. Call as soon as phone number is provided.

function.name: update_patient
function.description: Update specific fields of an existing patient record after confirming changes with the caller.

patient_id.description: UUID of the patient returned by find_patient_by_phone

function.name: schedule_appointment
function.description: Schedule an initial intake consultation appointment for a registered patient (Bonus Feature).

reason.description: Reason for visit or consultation topic
